# Trancespace – Aurora Edition

*Your room. The cosmos. One breath away.*

Trancespace Aurora Edition transforms your everyday surroundings into a living, breathing universe  a mixed reality experience where the walls of your room dissolve into deep space, and every beat, pulse, and wave of music shapes the cosmos around you.

Designed for those who seek stillness in sound and wonder in the everyday, Trancespace is not just something you listen to it's something you inhabit.
